plainTranslation: Their Moon in your 12th house can enter your unconscious before you have words for it. You may dream about them, absorb their moods, or feel responsible for feelings that were never clearly spoken. Ask what is real before you carry what is hidden.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Refined from approved project relationship source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
